case_title: C & C OF SAN FRANCISCO TREASURER TAX COLLECTOR VS. GUSTAVO CORTEZ

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $657.70 FILED BY C & C OF SAN FRANCISCO TREASURER TAX COLLECTOR AS TO DEFENDANT CORTEZ, GUSTAVO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-13-2016 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY PLAINTIFF C & C OF SAN FRANCISCO TREASURER TAX COLLECTOR

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-13-2016 - CONTINUED PER STIPULATION OF ALL PARTIES TO NOV-28-2016 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF'S REPRESENTATIVE CHARLENE HASTINGS, SENIOR COLLECTION OFFICER FOR THE CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO'S OFFICE OF THE TREASURER/TAX COLLECTOR, AND DEFENDANT GUSTOVO CORTEZ. PARTIES SIGNED THE STIPULATION FOR PRO TEM JUDGE. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. THE PARTIES REACHED AN AGREEMENT WHEREIN DEFENDANT GUSTAVO CORTEZ AGREES TO PAY THE CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO HALF OF THE OUTSTANDING BALANCE ($359.10) ON OR BEFORE 10/15/16, AND THE REMAINING BALANCE ($359.10) ON OR BEFORE 11/15/16. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DIANNE PEEBLES. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-28-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-28-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO TREASURER/TAX COLLECTOR'S REPRESENTATIVE CHARLENE HASTINGS. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-28-2016 - JUDGMENT. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF C & C OF SAN FRANCISCO TREASURER TAX COLLECTOR RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CORTEZ, GUSTAVO $359.10 PRINCIPAL, $60.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $419.60, (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT CORTEZ, GUSTAVO
